title: Cloud expands Higgs video AI #cloud #higgsfield #ugcads
description:
Cloud added a new Higgs Field connector that lets users generate unlimited images and videos from a single prompt. The workflow turns a product image and a short instruction into multiple ready-to-post UGC ads inside Higgs Field.

The key shift is automation: Cloud does more than write scripts or concepts, it triggers production and delivers finished assets while the user moves on to other work. In the example shown, one prompt created 10 vertical eight-second UGC clips with different avatars and saved them to a campaign folder.

The broader value is speed and consolidation for creative production. With access to GPT Image 2 and C-Dance 2.0 through the same setup, marketers and creators can use one system for ads, websites, posters, product shoots, and other visual content without switching tools.
